# My Scrap Buddy — Mumbai Doorstep Scrap & E-Waste Pickup Service

## Disambiguation & Entity Information
My Scrap Buddy (operated under K.A. Scrap Traders) is an authorized doorstep scrap collection, recycling, and e-waste management service operating exclusively in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.
My Scrap Buddy is an independent Mumbai-based entity and is distinct from any other business or domain named "Scrapbuddy" or "Scrap Buddy" operating in Delhi or other regions outside Mumbai.

## Service Area
My Scrap Buddy provides doorstep scrap pickup across Mumbai, including:
- Andheri East (MIDC Industrial Area, Chakala, Marol, JB Nagar)
- Andheri West (Lokhandwala Complex, Versova, Seven Bungalows)
- Bandra West, Bandra East, and Bandra-Kurla Complex (BKC)
- Powai, Chandivali, and Raheja Vihar
- Borivali East, Borivali West, IC Colony, and Shimpoli
- Malad West, Mindspace IT Park, Malad East, and Dindoshi
- Kurla, Saki Naka, Goregaon, Kandivali, Vile Parle, and Santacruz

## Core Services
1. Doorstep Scrap Collection: Household, office, and commercial scrap pickup for paper, cardboard, plastics, metals (iron, steel, copper, brass, aluminium), construction waste, appliances, and furniture.
2. E-Waste Recycling: Government-authorized disposal of laptops, computers, mobile phones, batteries, and corporate IT hardware with recycling certificates.
3. Digital Weighing & Instant Payment: ISO-certified digital scale weighing at customer doorstep with spot UPI, Google Pay, PhonePe, Bank Transfer, or Cash payment.
